title: SWF a11y: object 'Make accessible'=false (enabled:false) never emits _accProps.silent — disabled objects stay in screen-reader tree
description:
DONE (this commit). Fixed the _accProps emit gap in packages/swf/src/compiler/frames.ts: added hasSilent = (acc.enabled === false) to the emit gate and parts.push('_ap.silent = true;') when enabled===false, so unchecking 'Make object accessible' now hides the instance from MSAA via _accProps.silent=true. Emitted ALONGSIDE other a11y fields (Flash silences even when name/desc/shortcut/forceSimple are also set) — silent is merged, not exclusive. Added 2 unit tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/accessibility.test.ts: (1) enabled=false alone -> _accProps + silent + instanceName present; (2) enabled=false + name/description -> silent kept alongside name/desc. Updated docs/17-advanced-specialized.md. Document-level DocumentAccessibility.enabled left out of scope as specified.
